headline: Aequs Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange about sanction of Scheme of Amalgamation between Aequs Limited ("Transferee Company) and AeroStructures Manufacturing India Private Limited, Aequs Engineered Plastics Private…
detail: Amalgamation/Merger - Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange about sanction of Scheme of Amalgamation between Aequs Limited ("Transferee Company) and AeroStructures Manufacturing India Private Limited, Aequs Engineered Plastics Private Limited and Aequs Force Consumer Products Private Limited ( Transferor Companies ) and their respective members and creditors under Section 233 of the Companies Act, 2013
